draws.title: Water the Human
draws.message: Your body is not a machine for producing worth. It is a living altar.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: drink water, eat something, or unclench your jaw.

draws.title: Justice Star
draws.message: Care becomes power when it reaches beyond the self.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: amplify a voice, cause, or community that needs support.

draws.title: Gentle Mirror
draws.message: Speak to yourself like someone you are trying to keep alive and loved.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: replace one harsh thought with a kinder truth.

draws.title: Wish With Feet
draws.message: A wish becomes magic when it grows legs.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: turn one hope into one doable action.

draws.title: Cosmic Detour
draws.message: The scenic route may reveal the medicine you missed while rushing.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: let yourself be playful for five minutes.

draws.title: Moonbeam Ripple
draws.message: You may never see every ripple your kindness creates. Create it anyway.
draws.action: Scatter stardust: do one good thing without needing credit.
